Results.ReviewText: Is handy in every way. Is not heavy so you can roll it every where without effort. It keeps the temperature inside.
Results.Title: Best Grill ever

Results.ReviewText: Well made. High heat paint last for years. The kettle grill is an efficient great BBQ. Does everything from grill to rotisserie and smoke. For the price you can't get a better BBQ. The grill imparts a great flavor. Can add wood chips or chunks with charcoal. Very versatile. I would highly recommend. I BBQed on my previous one for 17 years.
Results.Title: A great BBQ at a great value.

Results.ReviewText: We scrapped the old natural gas dinosaur grill for the 22” with the ash catcher. Works great. Easy to use, easy to clean. Also used a Weber charcoal chimney. Another winner. A note on assembly:  follow the instructions!  The instructions are easy to follow if you don’t try to jump ahead!  Trust the Weber team who wrote the instructions.  We’ve had many very nice grilling days with this grill. Be sure to read all the emails you’ll receive after registering. Great tips. Great recipes. Good job, WeberTeam!
Results.Title: Excellent Choice

Results.ReviewText:
The iconic Weber 22 has not disappointed. My family has been faithful to Weber for years. I grew up watching my dad smoke Thanksgiving Turkeys on Weber charcoal grills. For about the last twenty years, I’ve cooked exclusively on Weber gas grills until I bought the 22 a month ago. As we all know, it takes a couple uses to learn any new grill so the first few items cooked, although delicious, weren’t my best work. I’ve since dialed it in and have enjoyed smoked ribs, smoked chicken, roasted peppers, corn, onions, potatoes, burgers, dogs, and chicken. 

After the first use, I noticed a chip in the enamel on the lid and although I couldn’t be 100% sure if it came that way, I emailed service and about a week later a new kid arrived. So, that was pretty awesome. 

I only have two issues with this grill and the first is that I waited so long to return to charcoal grilling. The second is that the little ledges the cooking grate sits on are not perfectly level so I have a little wiggle in the grate. It does not have any affect on cooking, I’m just a little OCD, so….

All in all, this is a great grill with a large cooking surface and can sear steak at 559-600, smoke a pork butt at 225, and everything in between. Do yourself a flavor and go buy one immediately! (see what I did there?!?! Lol)
Results.Title: YOU HAD ME AT HELLO

Results.ReviewText: This is a solid grill for the money -- the One Touch ash collection system and included charcoal baskets make this a solid choice for upgrading from the original kettle.   Pairs nicely with my Weber gas grill.
Results.Title: First choice for my second grill

Results.ReviewText: I used my kettle grill last night and everything cooked perfectly. Steaks salmon chicken and veges!!  I love the bronze color. Very rich in color!!
Results.Title: My Kettle Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Best Father’s Day present that arrived a little bit early. My partner has been making up a reason to use it daily and exploring so many different foods and cooking methods.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber charcoal grills are manufactured to the highest level and last a lifetime. This grill is the best by far and I will always own a Weber. From the paint process to the fine details this grill is definitely made with pride! I recommend this grill to anyone who is looking to grill, and have it last for a lifetime. I upgraded to the premium so I could give my ten year old grill to my daughter when she purchased her new home.
Results.Title: No better charcoal grill out there

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. I am a Weber fan through and through. I received this grill as a gift, but wanted it for a long time. I love being able to cook over charcoal as opposed to gas. Temps are easy to control and charcoal really gives a far superior flavor and sear than gas does!!
Results.Title: 22 inch Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Metal feels a bit more cheap than the previous versions. Worried about longevity.
Results.Title: You asked for it

Results.ReviewText: With all the fancy new styles of grills and smokers on the market today…this is still the best.
Results.Title: Timeless Classic

Results.ReviewText: Great grill does exactly what it suppose to do. Controlled heat is very easy once you get use to how to do it. Love the way the ashes can be removed.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText:
This is my second 22” kettle.
After 18 years of use it was time to get another one.
Results.Title: Best grill, great investment.

Results.ReviewText: I am enjoying this. Surprised how easy it is to control temperature.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with my long-overdue upgrade to this shiny green beauty. The hinged cooking grate and the one-touch venting / ash removal system are big improvements. It was time to retire my 25 year old 18” kettle, after years of service, since the charcoal grate was giving out and the old twist-style lower air vents were fused in place.  Really looking forward to putting some miles on this one!
Results.Title: Love my Green 22” Original

Results.ReviewText: Simple, classic, and versatile. Use it all the time.
Results.Title: Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: It gets the job done! This is a great grill! If done right you can smoke also. Great for beginners also.
Results.Title: What you need!

Results.ReviewText: This is my 2nd kettle charcoal grill, 1st one is 18 years old and I passed it on to someone else to enjoy grilling with charcoal.
Results.Title: Kettle charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Weber Kettle grill I have purchased.  I have a couple of other grills that I use for large scale cooking.  I really love my Weber.  It is very versatile and well made.  I also find it to be very portable for weekend trips to our lake cabin.  Take some time to learn has to use this grill.  You can do much more than simple grilling.  The Weber app gives you lots of ideas and teaches techniques to make anyone become more than an average griller.   This first Weber Kettle grill lasted me almost 15 years, probably would have lasted longer if had not left it at lake cabin for others to use it.  These are very nice well made grills that will last a long time.  Keep it covered when not in use and clean the ashes out when finished grilling.
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: My first charcoal grill.  I have found it easy to use (and clean).
Results.Title: Newbie griller.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Won’t find anything better. Charcoal saver. Will never buy anything different
Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: These aren't the quality you'd expect from a Weber grill.  They pale in comparison to the good ol' kettle grills our parents had growing up.  I wish I had just bought an old used model.
Results.Title: They Don't Make Them Like They Used To.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been using the 22’grill for a lifetime ..... it makes charcoal grilling simple,fun and delicious !
Results.Title: Weber charcoal grilling

Results.ReviewText: Great for BBQ beginners although I do recommend getting the one with the side table. Works well and is tons of fun If you enjoy bbq meat and veggies. Had a Weber before they are durable and last forever if you take care of them. I use mine for everything from pizza to smoking hot/cold to just simple hotdogs, hamburgers or beer can chicken or slow cook roasts. Its like your  instant pot just outside. I love it.
Results.Title: Great little BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Switched to a Weber Kettle after having many issues with my old propane grill and I should of made this switch a while ago. Not only is charcoal a much simpler grilling method, but the things that a Weber kettle can do out number a propane grill vastly. In the weeks of having my Kettle I have smoked tasty ribs, pulled pork, beer can chicken, and countless other tasty BBQ meals. Many of the above would have been hard on the propane grill mainly the smoked meats. Also with the Kettles sturdy construction and simple operation I don’t have to worry about parts breaking like on a propane grill. And lastly charcoal grilling may not be as quick as propane, but the charcoal taste makes up for it. If you are looking for a grill that does it all and you don’t want to pay the $$$ of a pellet grill I would 100% recommend getting a Weber Kettle. My only complaint of the grill would be the top air vent should have a handle to assist with opening it while hot, but this is nothing a BBQ glove can’t fix. There is also a large market and community revolving around kettle grills so you won’t be hard pressed to find grill modifications and how to videos. 3 additional components that I would recommend to get with your grill would be: a charcoal chimney for starting your charcoal, heavy duty metal tongs for shifting coals, and the Weber Charcoal baskets for better grilling by indirect heat. Even with these add one you are still south $100s of dollars of a pellet grill. 10/10 would recommend.
Results.Title: Should of bought one years ago.

Results.ReviewText: My parents gave us an older Weber grill while we lived in an apartment during graduate school, and after we moved into our first home many years ago, we inherited another old Weber from a friend who was moving out of the state.  Both of those grills were well used and reliable, but had been through may years of use before we took possession of them.  This new Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill (22" in a stunning copper finish) is our first brand new Weber ever, and our first premium kettle grill; I can't believe we waited so long to acquire one of our very own.  Delivery was quick (we ordered online), assembly was easy, and we smoked baby back ribs for a family cookout that turned out perfect.  The built-in thermometer is a necessity—not a luxury appointment—to ensure perfect grilling.  We expect to get many years of frequent use of this premium grill.  Don't wait: get yours today!
Results.Title: Loving this Original Weber Kettle Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I have been a griller for decades but always opted in for cheaper versions of charcoal grills. Thought the Weber brand was over rated. I bought my first Weber grill and it was the most amazing grilling experience I have ever had! I was able to completely control the cooking temperature the whole time. Fell in love with my Weber and looking forward to trying various accessories!
Results.Title: Love at 1st experience

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill!! I used to have a gas grill and missed the charcoal flavor. It’s the perfect size to either cook a steak and burgers for the family or for a large get together!! Will never go back to a gas grill again!!!
Results.Title: Love it.

Results.ReviewText: Simple Not much beats cooking on a charcoal grill!
Results.Title: Simple

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
